question: Should opt-in replay of locally modified packaged `dist` files become a supported `openclaw update` contract?
rationale: The implementation is technically defensible, but the new CLI flag and persistent recovery subsystem formally support a workflow that was previously outside the documented package-update contract.

options.title: Ship opt-in replay
options.body: Support trusted local packaged edits with automatic recovery capture and explicit replay after successful updates.

options.title: Preserve only
options.body: Capture and report recovery bundles but require users to restore trusted files manually.

options.title: Keep overrides unsupported
options.body: Do not preserve this workflow and document that modifying packaged `dist` files is incompatible with updates.

recommendation.title: Ship opt-in replay
recommendation.body: Support trusted local packaged edits with automatic recovery capture and explicit replay after successful updates.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned reviewer and strongest historical owner of the package-update and fs-safe integration surfaces.
